title: The 4 P's of Marketing Explained Simply | MBA Marketing Basics
description:
What makes some products sell like crazy? Smart companies plan four simple P's: Product, Price, Place and Promotion. In this short animated lesson we explain the marketing mix with one chocolate bar, so anyone can understand it.

In this video:
0:00 Why some products sell
0:06 Product
0:08 Price
0:10 Place
0:12 Promotion
0:15 Quick check
